lineage.strategy: Use latest issuer quarter to source order conversion, margin, liquidity and end-market concentration rather than older demand signals.

observations.fact: Powell's fiscal Q3 2026 results reported revenue of about $312 million, up 9% year over year, gross margin of 30.6%, and net income of $52.2 million.

New orders reached $934 million and backlog reached $2.4 billion as of June 30, 2026, up 69% year over year; the quarter included a data-center order exceeding $400 million plus LNG and petrochemical mega orders.
Cash and short-term investments were approximately $634 million at quarter end.

risks.risk: A meaningful portion of recent bookings is concentrated in several mega projects; backlog is not guaranteed revenue and project timing/cancellation or execution slippage can affect conversion.

unknowns.unknown: The evidence does not establish future margin on the record backlog or the ultimate cancellation/modification rate of mega projects.

recommendation: Use current revenue, margin, orders, backlog and liquidity as underwriting inputs while treating backlog conversion and mega-project concentration as explicit risk variables.
